module.Title: Poll a Sensor Until Target
module.Teaching: A while loop repeats as long as its condition remains True. The loop body must change something so it can eventually stop.
module.PredictionQuestion: Why does this loop eventually stop?
PredictionOptions: temperature increases until the condition becomes False
module.PredictionExplanation: The += operation moves temperature toward the target each iteration.
module.DebugPrompt: Subtracting moves the value away from the target and creates an endless loop.
module.RecallPrompt: Write the temperature polling loop from memory. Use these exact values: 1, 15, 20.
module.TransferPrompt: Increase tank_level from 40 until it reaches 50. Use the exact value 1.
module.PreviewMessage: The simulator can now represent a changing process value.
